protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: CVE-2026-32946 is PUBLISHED and identifies DNS-over-TCP as the Community-tier egress-policy:block bypass. In agent v0.14.3, addBlockRules ACCEPTs all TCP to 8.8.8.8, 8.8.4.4, and 1.1.1.1 without --dport or --uid-owner, while the local proxy listens only on UDP/53 and audit rules drop UDP/53, so dig +tcp can bypass allowed-endpoints.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: GitHub blame at agent v0.14.3 attributes the surviving unrestricted resolver ACCEPT mechanism to c793555005be99a734737f7bf8ebce54e545f3c6. Its patch creates firewall.go and first writes the TCP ACCEPT to 8.8.8.8; later commits only expand/restructure the resolver list.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: c793555005be99a734737f7bf8ebce54e545f3c6 has first parent 794340760181b0a57396ae8eaa9a3235f472994e. That parent's patch creates only .gitignore, LICENSE, and README.md, and firewall.go is absent (raw lookup returns 404), so the vulnerable mechanism is absent in the immediate parent.
